name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Otis' budget is lower than both the engineer using Graphene and the engineer with the Oscilloscope.
Bell, Hertz, and Otis go with Graphene, Tungsten, and $29k, in some order.
Either Wrench goes with Carbon or Graphene goes with $34k.
The engineer with the Blowtorch's budget is higher than both Otis and the engineer using Titanium.
Hertz, Otis, and $24k go with Titanium, Drill, and Oscilloscope, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Bell goes with $24k; Otis goes with Titanium; Graphene goes with Blowtorch.
If either $29k goes with Oscilloscope or Graphene does not go with Bell, then Edison goes with Oscilloscope.
